name: MALOR
description: Teleportation spell - behavior differs between camp and combat

campBehavior.input: Player inputs relative coordinate offsets (North/South, East/West, Up/Down)

dangers.solidRock: Teleporting into solid rock results in INSTANT PERMANENT PARTY DEATH - characters are LOST FOREVER, cannot be recovered
dangers.outsideBounds: Teleporting outside dungeon boundaries also kills party

restrictions.level10: Cannot teleport INTO Level 10 (Werdna's lair) but CAN teleport out

campBehavior.safetyTip: Use DUMAPIC first to determine safe coordinates. Teleport UP to Level 1 (no rock on ceiling), then MALOR to known-safe coordinates.

combatBehavior.destination: Random location on current dungeon level
combatBehavior.notes: Combat escape is SAFE (never into rock) but random destination means you may land in worse situation

notes: Most powerful utility spell but extremely dangerous in camp mode. Always use DUMAPIC first.
